description.value:
You summon a searing wall of light-side Force energy within range for the duration: either a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ring up to 60 feet in diameter with the same height and thickness. The wall grants three-quarters cover, and its space is difficult terrain.

A creature that enters the wall's space for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 6
